zh-CN: 默认进入仓库，并为首次使用的空仓库增加可跳过、可永久关闭的三步引导。
未压缩项目再次压缩时可选择更新或保留已有备份位置；界面文案、按钮和暗色活跃度同步完善。
视频抽帧保留原始比例、不再补黑边；发行与公共更新后备流程更稳健。
en-US: The app opens the Warehouse by default and adds a skippable three-step guide for first use.
Recompressing uncompressed items can preserve or update existing backup locations; interface copy, controls and dark activity colors are refined.
Video frames retain their original aspect ratio without black padding, with more robust release and public update fallback flows.
